name: LAVANYA NAYAK/ ଲାବଣ୍ୟ ନାୟକ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Lavanya Nayak writes poetry in Odia and is associated with Jajpur, Odisha. Her Kabita Live biography describes postgraduate study in Odia and an interest in gardening and reading. Her poem ‘ଅଧା ଅଧା ମୌସୁମୀ’ also appears in Odisha Sambad, where the byline and locality connect the publication to this writer.

In her Kabita Live contribution ‘ପ୍ରଳୟ’, the earth’s devastation prompts a series of urgent questions. The speaker asks why the heavens remain silent while homes disappear and the world loses its capacity to bear violence and arrogance. The poem turns from images of catastrophe towards an appeal for intervention and compassion.
